description: A Python script that provides a utility for resolving stack traces and crashes by symbolizing memory addresses using llvm-symbolizer. It supports multiple crash formats and includes functions for parsing and symbolizing addresses.

methods.name: _Symbolize
methods.description: Attempts to resolve memory addresses within a specified file containing stack traces or crash logs by matching lines against regex patterns and invoking llvm-symbolizer.

methods.name: _RunSymbolizer
methods.description: Uses an external llvm-symbolizer tool to resolve symbol names from a library and offset.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and initiates the symbolization process.
